shots.detail_en: Spectacle hook: the empty trading hall at midnight, a thousand screens glowing, each dark screen holding a small reflection of Changhong; he raises a hand, all reflections raise in unison (mirror-abyss anchor).
shots.sub: 旁白：那晚，大厅里有一千个我。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: At the washroom mirror, Changhong splashes his face and looks up: in the mirror his tie-tying gesture, half a beat late, morphs into Xiong Tiancheng's signature collar-smooth.
Changhong steps back; in the mirror the gesture snaps back to his own.
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The notebook's last page: the missing line traced over with a pencil into a question mark.
Office whiteboard: Changhong circles a full counter-attack deployment — smokescreen, hidden positions, cushion drawn as abstract symbols (methods abstracted — diagrams only, no technique).
shots.sub: 他用烟幕拆了我父亲。我照原样——还回去。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Back alley behind the VIP room: Changhong's shadow talks low with a few big players, cigarette tips flaring (rumor-seeding, minimal).
shots.sub: 大户（画外）：就这消息，能信？ 长：盘口会说谎。我让它说。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Vortex montage: board blocks twitching out of sync / whispers at the brokerage door / a crowd pressing around the news rack (rumor crowd — zero operational detail).
shots.sub: 旁白：三天，一只票的价格里长满了影子。撒影子的人，是我。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Blast point: mid-session, the target stock's intraday line dives like a kite with a snapped string (abstract curve).
On the hall steps, old retail investor Zhou sits crumpled, his pager trembling in his fist.
shots.sub: 老周：我戒了十年……怎么又……

shots.detail_en: Man Cang squeezes over to help old Zhou up, his face changing bit by bit.
shots.sub: 满仓：老周叔，您戒了十年哪！养老的底子哪能再全仓——是谁给您递的消息？
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Man Cang looks back toward the VIP box, then to the second-floor window spot where Changhong always stands — it is empty.
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Top floor: Xiong Tiancheng, having watched the board, claps three times at Changhong who has come to report.
shots.sub: 熊：好一招放风压价。93 年，我用这招拆过一个人——他姓陆。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong's pupils jolt; Xiong answers without admitting anything.
shots.sub: 长：你认了。 熊：我从来不认。我只说——市场惩罚的是贪婪的人。那位陆先生当年，是不是也信了不该信的盘口？
shots.speaker: CH+XIONG

shots.detail_en: Mirror-abyss: before the floor-to-ceiling window the two men's reflections face each other, neon flowing between them.
shots.sub: 熊：你看镜子里站着的人——多像。
shots.speaker: XIONG

shots.detail_en: Changhong punches the glass; the reflection shatters into mosaic pixels then slowly reassembles.
shots.sub: 我是他的儿子——不是你的影子！
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Behind a parking-garage pillar, Xiong Wei blocks Changhong and holds out a USB drive.
shots.sub: 熊伟：我父亲的档案库，七成是裁缝活儿。真的——在这里。价格：替我，盯住他。
shots.speaker: XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: The USB drive lies in Changhong's palm, stamped with a small Xiong family crest.
shots.sub: 长：你们父子，把我当什么？ 熊伟：变量。
shots.speaker: CH+XIONGWEI

shots.detail_en: Changhong pockets the drive — neither accepting nor returning it.
shots.sub: 长：等我理清楚——你父亲的账、你的账，一起算。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Archive room: Hongli overlays the genuine ledger against that '1993 page' against the light — a line of stitched mendwork shows up.
shots.sub: 红：这页是后缝上去的。有人在你父亲的账上——动了针脚。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Hongli picks up the phone, then puts it down, gazing out the window.
shots.sub: 红：他在喂你一本假账。可你最近喂自己的——又是什么？
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Midnight rooftop: USB drive in the left pocket, empty envelope in the right; the watch ticks against his wrist — accurate now.
shots.sub: 爸，两本账都说是你。我该信哪一本？
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Black frame end card for next episode.
shots.sub: 有人动过你父亲的账。而动针脚的手，比你想象的更年轻。
shots.card: 有人动过你父亲的账。而动针脚的手，比你想象的更年轻。
